name: dairy-rebuild-v4
description: The Dairy rebuild's ACTION layer, switched off. READ THIS BEFORE READING THE ARM, because it is the same caveat the Wheat and Orchard arms carry and it is load-bearing: a suit rebuild is a data-and-handler change, not a set of numbers, so NO OVERLAY CAN EXPRESS "the Dairy suit as it was". A knob cannot un-write the Farmstead diversion that puts a build's payment into the barn instead of the discard, cannot restore the turn-1 crop substitution or the second Build ACTION for GBP 2 that the two old Farmstead faces sold, cannot put back the barn payment and the coins-as-cards that D8 and D7 used to grant, and cannot un-turn three Tier 3 cards from GROW-gated buildings into printed ACTIONs. Against the shipped game this arm therefore isolates the ONE piece of the rebuild an overlay can reach: D13 The Cheese Vault, D14 The Cream Refinery and D15 The Grand Creamery, the three cards that print an ACTION taken instead of a main action. Base is the rebuild with them in, this cell is the rebuild with them out, and the delta is what the action layer is worth. THE TWO CONDITIONS THAT DECIDE THE REBUILD ARE NOT MEASURED HERE - cards into a Dairy seat's barn, up from 10.2 against Orchard's 25.7, and deliveries per Dairy seat, up from 2.0 against 5.8 - and both are before-and-after against the committed reference run, not against this cell. So is every diagnosis: activations per card built up from 0.16 and Tier 1 activations up from 0.12; D13/D14/D15 play rate up sharply from the Tier 3 baseline of about 2% and Tier 3 firings per card built up from 0.63; builds per Dairy seat and the share of Dairy turns with no build available, both new counters printed in THE YARD; cards taken off deck tops per game and reshuffles per played deck flat at 5 to 8, which is the likeliest thing to break because three Dairy cards pull off deck tops and D15 BUILDS them so they never return; the median Grand Creamery run length, where 1 is a disappointment machine and 3 is too strong; rival cards onto the Builder's Yard up from 2.8; Dairy's win rate up from 10.6% and the suit spread down from 22.0 points; visits per turn at or above 0.51 with the bonus-slot mix still at least 70% visit. RUN THE BUILDER'S YARD DISCOUNT AND THE DECK CHANGES AS SEPARATE ARMS: they fix different faults - traffic, and freight manufacture - and will otherwise be credited to each other. Read the noise floor before believing any of it. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⛔ DELIVERY MEEPLE PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the delivery meeple ON as the shipped default (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) together with two new island rules, the space choice (rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true: a delivery names either free space) and the closing draw (rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: filling a tile draws one card per crate). This overlay predates it, so all six leaves are pinned here BY NAME at their pre-ruling values (deliveryMeepleSpace null, meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null, meepleSpendDistinctColours false, deliverySpaceChoice false, closingDrawPerCrate 0; 'start' and null are the old inert values, not 'none' and 0) and it still replays its own game. Since 16/09/2026 the balloons, the Aerodrome, the Village Store, the closing draw and the wild substitution are deleted from the engine, so this overlay no longer replays the game it was recorded on. Its pins for the balloons and the Aerodrome, the Village Store and the closing draw were removed with them. ⚠️ 16/09/2026, THE TOKEN ISLAND AND THE TURN-ORDER RULINGS: the island is now two tokens per tile (Dean, R3: a first delivery pays both demands and chooses its token, a second pays the last token plus 2 any; Workers sit on the 3 and 4 VP tokens), and the Vegetable and Dairy boards were retexted (R9, R10), so this overlay's pins of rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice, rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace were removed with the delivery spaces. It pins rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.vegetableWildCards 0 and dairyDiscount 0 by name, and island.tokens.workerOnVp [] because its game had no island meeple, and it now starts with seat 0 and gives one more turn each (rules.setup.firstPlayer 'seat0', rules.endGame.endOfGame 'oneMoreTurnEach'). It no longer replays the game it was recorded on, and nothing measured before 16/09/2026 is comparable as a level.
